stx.text: The Hall of Oracles is where Extus Narr descends during the Oriq attack to harness the Snarl, blasting open its doors, and he begins to read the ritual while Oriq agents arrange books and scrolls.

Extus translocates Liliana away and breaks the Kenrith twins' spells, and as blood pools across the floor and the Snarl turns from blue to deep red, he calls upon the Blood Avatar, which rises from the blood fountain.

Rowan draws on the power of the Snarl but is drained, and Will casts a red halo control spell on the Blood Avatar with Rowan's last energy, so that it crushes Extus before taking Will's right leg as it is pulled back into the Snarl.
The hall collapses, and Deans Nassari and Lisette rescue the twins from the falling rubble.
